decisions.rule: Do not merge Camilla Stephenson, Camilla Stevenson, Camila Stevenson and Kamilah Stevenson without direct public identity evidence.

Maintain a partial candidate-video catalogue with exact URLs, publication dates and dated engagement snapshots. Do not call it exhaustive without a verified channel ID and complete public uploads feed.
YouTube metadata and third-party channel analytics are source-specific observations; conflicting subscriber/video counts remain separate and are not averaged.
Creator opinions, personal holdings claims and affiliate-linked narratives are public-discourse context only; they are not XRP spot flows, custody evidence or forecast features.
